description: a project member who is neither an admin nor the creator: the modify refusal naming the post ID
difference: The old API let any member of the owning project change the survey; the bridge applies Studio's permissions (ADR 0040 point 1, ADR 0009): a member who is neither a project admin nor the survey's creator gets the action's refusal. The old answer here was an empty 200.

body.json: You are not authorized to modify the survey {{survey.postId}}
